rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being ill or in poor health.

example.english: I'm sick today, so I'm not going to work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 beng6 zo2 m4 faan1 gung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when you are fed up with A after too much repetition or delay.

example.english: I'm sick of you being late every time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau6 gau3 nei5 ci3 ci3 ci4 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the physical feeling of nausea or wanting to vomit.

example.english: I feel sick as soon as I smell that.
example.jyutping: jat1 man4 dou2 zan6 mei6 ngo5 zau6 faan2 wai6

rows.note: Use this slang adjective for someone or something disturbingly abnormal, including a twisted or tasteless joke.

example.english: The jokes he tells are really sick.
example.traditional: 佢講呢啲笑話真係好變態。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 ni1 di1 siu3 waa6 zan1 hai6 hou2 bin3 taai3
